grok.name: Which schema, data contract, application profile or content standard does this dataset or distribution declare conformance to, and which sibling schema record in WM-DAT-004 holds the structure?

claude_only.name: Which system is the master for this dataset's identifier, and what is the identifier it assigns?
Does a governed persistent identifier (DOI, Handle, ARK, resolvable IRI) exist, who registered it, and what does it resolve to?
Does the identifier denote the abstract dataset or one specific version of it?
Which alternate or legacy identifiers must be kept resolvable to avoid breaking existing references?
What title, description and language variants are authoritative for this dataset?
In which catalogue or register is this dataset listed, and under what record identifier?
What is the current listing state of the record, and who may change it?
How do record creation and modification times differ from the dataset's own issued and modified times?
Is the same dataset listed in more than one catalogue, and which listing is authoritative?
Which controlled vocabularies are mandatory for themes in the governing profile, and which terms apply?
What general resource type best describes this asset, and does the target profile constrain the allowed values?
Which free-text keywords are maintained, in which languages, and who curates them?
Is the dataset designated under a regulatory category such as an EU high-value dataset thematic category?
What population or universe does the dataset claim to cover, and is coverage a census, a sample or opportunistic?
What is the unit of observation of one record, and does it differ from the unit of analysis?
Which variables are measured, and by what measurement technique?
What spatial and temporal resolution do the records carry, and what is the smallest reportable granularity?
What start and end instants does the data content cover, and is the interval open-ended?
What is the reference date of the content, as distinct from the date the metadata was recorded?
When was the dataset last updated and when is the next update expected?
Which time zone or offset applies to the timestamps inside the data, and is it recorded explicitly?
What geographic extent does the dataset cover, expressed as named places, codes or a bounding geometry?
Which coordinate reference system do the coordinates use, and is it stated by registry identifier?
What is the spatial resolution or smallest geographic unit released, and does disclosure control coarsen it?
If the dataset has no spatial dimension, is that recorded explicitly rather than left empty?
Is conformance asserted by the publisher or verified by a validator, and where is the evidence?
Where is the field-level data dictionary published, and does it cover code lists and missing-value conventions?
How is divergence between the declared schema and the served data detected and reported?
Is this dataset a member of a dataset series, and what identifies the series?
Which member precedes and follows this one, and on what ordering property?
Is a new release a new series member or a new version of the same dataset, and which rule decides?
Does the dataset aggregate identifiable parts or subsets that are themselves catalogued?
Which distributions exist for this dataset, and what media type and format does each use?
What checksum algorithm and value is published for each distribution, and when was fixity last verified?
Is the distribution packaged in a container profile such as a data package or research object crate, and where is its descriptor?
Are the distributions semantically equivalent renderings of the same content, or do some carry reduced or transformed content?
What byte size and record volume should a consumer plan for, and how volatile is that size?
Which services serve this dataset, and what is the endpoint URL and description of each?
What protocol or API standard does each endpoint implement, and which conformance classes does it declare?
What rate limits, pagination, quota or payload limits apply to programmatic access?
Is a bulk download path available alongside the API, as required for designated public-sector datasets?
What is the declared access level of this dataset, using the governing profile's vocabulary?
What authentication and authorisation does each channel require, and who can approve a grant?
If access is restricted, what is the request process, expected decision time and appeal route?
Is an embargo in force, when does it lift, and what becomes available at that moment?
When the data itself is restricted, does descriptive metadata remain publicly visible?
Which licence applies to each distribution, identified by a governed licence identifier rather than free text?
Who holds the rights being licensed, and on what basis do they hold them?
What attribution text or citation must a re-user reproduce?
Does the metadata carry a different licence from the data itself?
Does a legal obligation constrain the licence choice, such as an open licence mandate for designated datasets?
Which actions are permitted, prohibited or subject to a duty, and for which assignee parties?
Do third-party rights encumber part of the content, and which part?
Are there purpose limitations, such as research-only use or a prohibition on training models?
Is the policy expressed in a machine-readable form an agent can evaluate before use?
Which party is accountable for the content and service level of this dataset?
How do the holder, publisher, creator and catalogue operator differ for this asset, and are any the same party?
What contact point is published, and is it a durable role address rather than an individual?
Who is the operational steward responsible for updates, quality checks and metadata upkeep?
Does the dataset contain personal or otherwise sensitive data, and which components carry it?
On what legal basis or consent is the sensitive content processed and published?
What de-identification or statistical disclosure control has been applied, and with what residual risk?
Could this dataset be combined with others to re-identify individuals, and is that risk documented?
If special-category data is retained solely for bias detection, are the required safeguards documented?
Which activity generated this version, when did it start and end, and which agent was responsible?
To whom is the dataset attributed, as distinct from who published it?
How far back does asset-level lineage go here before the question is delegated to the lineage model?
By what mode and instrument was the data collected or generated?
Which preparation operations - cleaning, joining, labelling, aggregation - were applied, and in what order?
What assumptions or design choices does the production method embed that a re-user must know?
Can the production be re-executed, and what would be needed to reproduce this exact output?
What versioning scheme is used, and does a new version get a new persistent identifier?
Which version precedes this one, which supersedes it, and which is currently authoritative?
What changed relative to the previous version, and is the change breaking for consumers?
Which event triggers a new version rather than an in-place correction?
What update frequency is declared, using which controlled vocabulary?
How does actual release timing compare with the announced calendar?
What is the current status of the asset - draft, in development, stable, deprecated - and who sets it?
Is any part served in real time or near real time, and what latency is guaranteed?
Is the dataset deprecated or withdrawn, when did that take effect and on whose decision?
What supersedes the withdrawn dataset, and how are consumers redirected?
What does the tombstone record state, and does it keep the citation and identifier resolvable?
How is removal signalled to downstream catalogues that previously harvested this record?
Which retention rule applies, what is the retention period and what triggers its start?
What preservation commitment has the holder made, and for which distributions?
When data is deleted, what is deleted, what metadata is retained, and where is the deletion evidenced?
How are conflicts resolved between an erasure obligation and an archival or legal-hold obligation?
Which metric was computed, in which quality dimension, and what value resulted?
What exactly was measured - the whole dataset, one distribution, or a subset?
When was the measurement computed, and against which dataset version?
What threshold makes the result acceptable, and who set it?
Do certificates or user feedback annotations exist alongside computed measurements?
For which stated purpose has fitness been assessed, and what was the verdict?
What known limitations, caveats or coverage gaps must a re-user account for?
Which uses are explicitly discouraged or unsupported by the holder?
Are there breaks in series or definitional changes that prevent comparison across time or units?
Is the dataset described in a machine-readable ML format that resolves files to record sets and typed fields?
How were labels or annotations produced, by whom, and with what agreement or review?
What is documented about representativeness relative to the target population and about examined biases?
Is training a model on this dataset permitted, restricted or prohibited, and by which instrument?
Are canonical splits or benchmark subsets defined at asset level, or left to the consuming training run?
Which application profiles does this entry declare conformance to, at which versions?
Which properties are mandatory under each declared profile, and are all of them populated?
What validation was run, against which rule set, and what were the violations?
What information is lost or coerced when projecting this entry into a given profile?
Where two declared profiles disagree on a property's obligation or vocabulary, which prevails?
Was this entry authored locally or harvested, and from which source catalogue?
Which datestamp drives incremental harvesting, and at what granularity is it exposed?
What deleted-record support does the source declare, and how are removals propagated?
May local edits override harvested values, and how is the divergence recorded and reconciled?
How are duplicate entries for the same dataset across federated catalogues detected and merged?
What is the recommended citation for this dataset, and which version does it pin?
Which typed relations to other resources are asserted, using which relation-type vocabulary?
Are related references qualified enough for a machine to know the direction and nature of each link?
Who must be credited in the citation, and how are contributor roles distinguished from creators?

grok_only.name: Which authoritative master-system identifier uniquely names this dataset in the holder or repository of record, and which system assigned it?
If a DOI, catalogue IRI and local key all exist, which identifier is the citation identifier and which is the catalogue resource IRI?
Are the dataset identifier, each distribution identifier, each data-service identifier and the catalogue-record identifier pairwise distinct, and is any of them a date?
What is the preferred title and abstract of this dataset in each declared metadata language?
What landing page, if any, does the original data provider publish, as distinct from aggregator or catalogue pages?
Which creator, publisher, title, publication year and identifier should be used to build a DataCite-style citation, and are any mandatory values replaced by DataCite unknown-information codes?
Is this catalogued resource a Dataset, DatasetSeries, DataService, Catalog, or another dcat:Resource subclass, and which dcterms:type or DataCite resourceTypeGeneral is declared?
Which theme concepts apply, from which concept scheme, and is the EU NAL data-theme vocabulary required for the exchange profile in force?
If ISO 19115 identification metadata is maintained, what MD_Scope code distinguishes dataset, dataset series, service or other resource kinds?
Which catalogue lists this resource, and which catalogue record has this resource as its sole primary topic?
When was the dataset issued by the holder, when was it listed in this catalogue, and when was the catalogue record last modified?
If this listing was harvested, what is the source catalogue record and what editorial change type applies to the local record?
Which datasets, data services and child catalogues are members of this catalogue, and is the catalogue empty?
Under which application profile (DCAT 3, DCAT-AP 3.0, DCAT-US or another) is this catalogue exported, and which controlled vocabularies are mandatory in that profile?
If the same dataset is listed in several catalogues, which listing is the holder catalogue of record versus a harvested copy?
Is each distribution obtained by a direct download URL, a landing page, a mediated form, or an access service endpoint?
Do the distributions of this dataset serialize the same information, or do they differ by subset, language, profile, spatial resolution or schema?
What IANA media type and, if needed, additional format URI or label apply to each distribution?
What checksum algorithm and digest authenticate each downloadable distribution, and do they match bytes actually retrieved?
Is the download compressed or packaged, and which inner media type is the payload after unpacking?
What declared byte size applies, and is a size or digest mismatch treated as a failed distribution rather than as the same asset?
What endpoint URL and endpoint description document the operations of this data service, and which API standard does the service conform to?
Which datasets does this service serve, and which distributions, if any, expose the service as their accessService?
What authentication, authorisation or network restriction is required to call the endpoint, as distinct from the licence on the dataset?
Does dcterms:conformsTo on the service describe the API, while dataset or distribution conformsTo describes the payload schema or data specification?
Which licence applies to each distribution and to the dataset as a whole, and is any distribution under a different licence from its siblings?
What access-rights class applies (for example public, restricted, non-public), and which technical or legal conditions must a consumer satisfy before use?
Which legislation or regulation mandates publication, sharing or restriction of this dataset in the relevant jurisdiction?
If the dataset is not under a standard public licence, what data-sharing agreement or API access contract authorises use, and who are the parties?
Is this asset an explicit DatasetSeries, a single Dataset with several distributions, or a mis-modelled series stored as one dataset with many files?
Which datasets are members of the series, and which are first, previous and last along the series dimension?
Which expected series slices are missing, delayed or superseded, and does the series remain current?
What version tag identifies this dataset release, and which resource is the current version of the same work?
Which previous version does this resource succeed, which resources does it replace or obsolete, and which DataCite relationTypes apply if DOIs are used?
If the dataset is continuously updated, is this identifier bound to a snapshot, to a time-stamped query, or to a living work that is not citable as a fixed entity?
What status applies now (under development, completed, deprecated, withdrawn or a profile equivalent), and what event produced that status?
Is the dataset under embargo, until when does the embargo last, and which access-rights value applies during embargo versus after release?
If the dataset is withdrawn or invalidated, is a tombstone retained at the persistent identifier, are distributions disabled, and what successor if any is declared?
For the latest status change, what is the event time on the asset versus the observation or ingestion time on the catalogue record or harvest?
What time period does the data content cover, and is the end open because the dataset is still accruing?
How frequently is the dataset expected to be updated, and what temporal resolution do the observations have?
If DataCite dates are recorded, which dates are Collected, Valid, Issued, Available, Updated or Withdrawn, and which of those are event times versus coverage?
What named places, gazetteer IRIs or geometries describe the spatial coverage of the data content?
What spatial resolution in metres, equivalent scale, or other resolution measure applies, if any?
In which coordinate reference system are coverage geometries expressed, and is that CRS recorded here or only in a geospatial sibling profile?
When did this dataset adopt the current schema version, and which previous schema version did it leave?
What validation evidence exists for the declared conformance, and is that evidence a SHACL or schema-validation artifact in WM-DAT-004 rather than a catalogue field?
Is there a primary source, revision, quotation or other PROV-qualified derivation that must be distinguished from a generic derivedFrom link?
Is a lineage statement or ISO LI_Lineage record present, mandatory under the applicable profile, and complete enough to replay the derivation in WM-DAT-006?
Which quality metrics, dimensions and values have been computed on this dataset or distribution, when, and by whom?
For which stated purposes has fitness been asserted or certified, and is that judgement from the publisher, a third-party certificate, or user feedback?
If multiple agents published conflicting quality statements, which statements are in force for catalogue display versus steward dashboards?
Who is the data holder accountable for content and service levels, and is that party the same as the catalogue publisher?
Who are the creators and contributors, with which identifiers and DataCite contributor types or PROV roles?
What contact point receives comments, quality feedback and access requests for this dataset?
Which funders or awards supported creation of the dataset, and do any of those awards impose deposit, embargo or licence obligations without transferring holdership?
What legal constraints and security classification apply to the dataset bytes versus to the catalogue metadata?
Does the dataset contain personal or otherwise disclosive data, and which processing lawful basis or statistical disclosure rule governs access?
What use limitations, purpose restrictions or prohibited uses are declared, beyond the licence document?
After withdrawal or legal erasure, does the persistent identifier still resolve to a tombstone, and are prior checksums retained as evidence of what was removed?
Must distribution bytes be erased, encrypted-beyond-use, or only delisted, and under which request or schedule?
Is reuse of the retired dataset identifier forbidden, and which successor identifier should consumers follow?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
